newsitem.title: JAPAN: Investor interest spreads to Takeda Chemical.
newsitem.headline: Investor interest spreads to Takeda Chemical.

text.p: Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd gained in early Monday morning trade, as investor interest in global issues spread to the pharmaceutical company, brokers said.
At 0102 GMT, the shares were 60 yen higher at 2,290 yen, renewing its high for the year.
"The buying is part of the enthusiasm over blue-chip issues, such as Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd," a "Big Four" broker said.
"Takeda is a leading name in the sector and that is helping investors pick the issue over other ones."
Sankyo Co Ltd, another pharmaceutical firm, was also higher at a record high of 3,120 yen, after rising 70 yen.
